description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_Generator, which is responsible for generating HTML output from tokens, including handling attributes, escaping, and special cases like script tags. It appears to be a core component in an HTML purification library, and contains functions for token-based HTML rendering, attribute handling, and configuration management.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Generator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating sanitized HTML output from tokens with support for configuration and handling of specific tags like <script> and <object>.

methods.name: generateFromTokens
methods.description: Generates HTML output from an array of HTMLPurifier tokens, with optional tidying and newline normalization based on configuration.

methods.name: generateFromToken
methods.description: Generates HTML for a single token, handling different token types such as start, end, empty, text, and comment, with support for Flash object handling.

methods.name: generateScriptFromToken
methods.description: Specialized method for handling <script> tag contents, wrapping them in CDATA sections and comments.

methods.name: generateAttributes
methods.description: Generates HTML attribute strings from an associative array of attributes, with options for sorting, minimization, and special IE workarounds.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes raw text data to safe HTML entities using htmlspecialchars.
